entries.title: Genesis 18:1
segments:
The Lord; Jehovah. 
 
  Plains of Mamre;

entries.title: Genesis 18:3
segments: My Lord; a token of respect, addressed to one who appeared to be chief.

entries.title: Genesis 18:4
segments: Wash your feet; as the feet were then protected only with sandals, or soles fastened on with straps, it was customary with travellers, when they stopped, to wash their feet.

entries.title: Genesis 18:5
segments:
Therefore are ye come; intimating that they had been providentially directed there, that he might thus entertain them. 
 
A pious mind is accustomed to recognize the hand of God in all the events of providence, and to glorify him by doing good to men.

entries.title: Genesis 18:8
segments: We should not be forgetful to entertain strangers, for thereby some have entertained angels, and also the Lord of angels; and acts of kindness done for his sake, even to the least of his disciples, he will remember and reward, as if done to himself.

entries.title: Genesis 18:10
segments:
I will--return; will visit thee again; namely, by giving thee a son by Sarah. 
 
  According to the time of life; supposed to mean the usual time from the conception to the birth of a child. But some prefer to render, "at the reviving of the year."

entries.title: Genesis 18:12
segments: Sarah laughed; a sign of unbelief, for which she is rebuked.

entries.title: Genesis 18:15
segments: The commission of one sin makes way for the commission of another; and the disbelief of God's word is a fruitful source of manifold and aggravated transgressions.

entries.title: Genesis 18:16
segments: Looked toward Sodom; as if they would go that way.

entries.title: Genesis 18:19
segments: Family religion is peculiarly pleasing to God, and he requires that parents not only counsel and advise, but command that their children to keep the way of the Lord; and there is an intimate connection between their doing this, and his bestowing upon them and their children the richest spiritual and temporal blessings.

entries.title: Genesis 18:20
segments: The cry of Sodom; the cry concerning the sin of Sodom.

entries.title: Genesis 18:21
segments: I will know; act with knowledge, and treat them as their case may require.

entries.title: Genesis 18:22
segments: The men; the two beings in human form, who accompanied Jehovah, and who at evening entered Sodom.
The Lord; Jehovah, who had been speaking to Abraham.

entries.title: Genesis 18:24
segments: Those who love God love their fellow men, and earnestly supplicate for them the mercies which they need.

entries.title: Genesis 18:32
segments: Prayer has great influence with God; and those who rightly offer it are eminently benefactors of mankind.  From regard to them, God may delay his judgments, and in answer to their prayers bring the wicked to repentance and salvation.
